LESSON: ANALYSIS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: APPRECIATION IN CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Out
Topic 3.1: Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we analyse Creative Arts and Sports work?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ANALYSIS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: ANALYSIS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Study Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we analyse Creative Arts and Sports work?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the role of analysis in Creative Arts and Sports.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
